I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message: nothing in the channel shows a deadline being agreed. The only date is Pree's post there on 14 October, which says the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due 25 August. I told him 25 August had already passed when she posted it. I'd asked her in her thread whether she meant a different date or next August, and she hasn't answered yet. So I suggested he check with her before updating the account sheet.

Before answering, I confirmed Hollis is a member of #central-team. A signing deadline is an operational fact, so no approval was needed.

The summary I wrote for you last turn also appeared in #central-team as a separate message, outside any thread. It contains nothing sensitive and everyone in the channel could already see the thread it describes, but it's extra noise there.
